lines: Persistent pain and insomnia with expressed desire to end life; inquiries about physician-assisted suicide

The patient is a 72-year-old female with Stage IV invasive ductal carcinoma with bone metastases, recurrent malignancy-associated hypercalcemia, and calcium pyrophosphate deposition disease, who returns to the palliative care clinic with her family.
She has been on multiple lines of chemotherapy and recently started a new regimen.

She expresses a desire to "just end it all" and inquires about physician-assisted suicide.
